title: Urban materials: concrete, asphalt, ceramic and stone tiles, white and black marble
summary: 6 tiling 1K PBR materials for modern spaces: concrete, asphalt, tiles_white, tiles_stone, marble_white, marble_black; triplanar + UV versions.
use_when: Modern or urban scenes: roads, parking lots, bunkers, arenas, lobbies, bathrooms, labs, temples, museum floors.
how_to_use: Assign with mesh_instance.material_override = load("res://starter/mat-urban/<name>_triplanar.tres") (or CSGShape3D.material = ...). _triplanar files map in world space at real-world scale with no UVs: use them for level geometry, CSG, BoxMesh/PlaneMesh floors and walls, terrain chunks; pieces placed side by side tile seamlessly. Do not use _triplanar on moving or animated objects (the texture slides); use <name>.tres there and set uv1_scale to mesh size in metres divided by the repeat size. To tint, duplicate the material and set albedo_color. Marble and white tiles are glossy (roughness about 0.05-0.3) and look best with a sky or reflection probe in the scene.
